## Featured Software Projects

### 1. Real-Time Messaging Platform
- **Category**: Real-Time Communication & Full-Stack Web Application
- **Live URL**: https://real-time-chat-rosy-phi.vercel.app/
- **Key Features**: Bi-directional instant messaging via Socket.io/WebSockets, end-to-end user authentication with JSON Web Tokens (JWT), online/offline presence indicators, conversation history persistence in MongoDB, responsive dark-mode UI with Tailwind CSS.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Node.js, Express, Socket.io, MongoDB, JWT, Tailwind CSS.

### 2. Collaborative Coding Interview Platform
- **Category**: Developer Productivity & Real-Time Collaboration
- **Live URL**: https://coding-platform-jet-two.vercel.app/
- **Key Features**: Synchronized code editor supporting multiple programming languages, integrated high-definition video conferencing powered by Stream Video SDK, sandboxed code execution engine, session management, and candidate evaluation interface.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Node.js, Express, Stream Video SDK, Monaco Editor / CodeMirror, REST APIs, Tailwind CSS.

### 3. MPLADS Risk Monitor
- **Category**: Governance Analytics, Data Visualization & Anomaly Detection
- **Live URL**: https://mplad-risk-monitor.vercel.app/
- **Key Features**: Comprehensive analytics dashboard analyzing Members of Parliament Local Area Development Scheme (MPLADS) fund allocations, multi-dimensional risk scoring for project delays, contractor concentration risk detection, anomaly identification, and interactive district/constituency visualizations.
- **Tech Stack**: React, Python / FastAPI, Tailwind CSS, Recharts / Chart.js, RESTful Data APIs.
